annotations.text:
1. Type first

The one irreversible choice moves to the top of creation, above name and description. Today it sits last, under a photo uploader that does nothing.

2. Draft + readiness checklist

Closes a real hole: today a programme goes public the moment it has one offer, even with zero content. Nothing is visible at klubyou.co/maya until Publish, and the checklist is the page's answer to "what do I do next?"

3. Recurrence, for real

The existing Repeats dropdown is collected and thrown away - you get one class. Here one form creates the whole series and shows exactly which dates it will make before you commit.

4. Published Live programme

Next class and its joining link stay pinned at the top. The stat strip is new - the page now answers "is this working?", not just "what's in it". Per-programme revenue needs payments to carry a programmeId; today they store a display string.

5. Recorded programme

Lessons are added inline on the row, not through a modal per lesson - a 20-lesson curriculum is currently 20+ modal round-trips.
